document: DoH Circular 2026/144: Mandatory Submission of Referral Data to Malaffi
text: Subject: Mandatory Submission of Referral Data to Malaffi in Support of Abu Dhabi Primary Care Model We extend our greetings and best wishes for your continued success. The exchange of referral data through Malaffi is a critical enabler of the Abu Dhabi Primary Care Model, supporting care coordination, continuity of care, referral tracking, and enhancing patient journeys across the healthcare system. The Malaffi e- Referral capability is intended to facilitate referral management, status monitoring, and communication between referring and receiving providers. Hence, the Department of Health (DoH) reiterates that all healthcare facilities are required to ensure the complete, accurate, and timely submission of referral data to the Malaffi Health Information Exchange Platform. All healthcare facilities must submit all referral transactions to Malaffi using the specifications of the REF HL7 messages type to send the main attributes of referrals such as priority and SNOMED coded specialty, both of which are clarified under “Referral priority and SNOMED Referral services code sets" Compliance Deadline All Healthcare facilities must achieve full compliance with this circular by no later than August 31, 2026. Regulatory Enforcement DoH will monitor compliance through Malaffi data and utilization reports. Failure to comply with this circular may result in regulatory actions in accordance with applicable DoH regulations, standards, and licensing requirements.
